Name: Nyapu-Style Sunberry Village
Author: nugmods
Description:
Nyapu-Style portraits for the expansion [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url] by skellady and sophiesalacia! Mod currently includes 23(!) portraits for the base SBV expansion, plus addons [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14286]Wren the Plumber[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]Rose and the Alchemist[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33615?tab=description]Dao[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32660]Ripley the Farmer[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12000?tab=description]Jonghyuk & Spanner[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32689?tab=description]Lani[/url]!

[b]THE 2.0 UPDATE ROLLS ALL ADDON NPCS INTO THE MAIN FILE IN PREPARATION FOR FUTURE SEASONAL PORTRAITS. BE SURE TO DELETE THE OLD FILES WHEN YOU UPDATE.[/b]

These portraits were made with a combination of Nyapu's original pixel art and my own edits made from scratch. All credit goes to Nyapu for their original work, of course, with many thanks for their generous permissions. In the future, if/when Nyapu does their own take on Sunberry Village, I encourage you to go support them as well—they're the og and this mod wouldn't have been possible without them!

Other cool Nyapu mods to check out:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33989]Nyapu-Style Lani[/url] by applewithworm!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/34575?tab=description]Elias - A Personal Redraw[/url] by Kaeldraws!

[b]Install Instructions (I am whispering directly in your ear, do it this way):
[/b]
1. Put the Content Patcher file in your mods folder, where all your other Content Patcher files are.

2. There are no more steps anymore! Just do that. The Evil (Custom Companions Raccoon) is Defeated.

[size=4][u]*[b][color=#ff0000]FOR DAO SPECIFICALLY:[/color][/b] make sure you set her seasonal config to "regular" or "off." My mod does not cover her randomized seasonals.[/u][/size]


[b]DO NOT:[/b]

1. Try to install this like a replacer. It's not a replacer. I don't care that the other Nyapu mods you downloaded are replacers. This one isn't. 

2. Put "[CP] Sunberry Village" into the main Sunberry Village folder. You will fuck up all your mods. Don't do it.

3. Use Vortex. Not for this mod, I turned it off, but in general. It's bad for Stardew Modding. Stop that. Learn how to mod the right way.

4. Come into my comments to complain about stuff that's already answered in the mod description.  Especially don't be a dick about it unless you really wanna find out
